description.value: Alfred House is a grand 4-bedroom Queen Anne style heritage home built in 1905, set within Ruckle Heritage Farm — the oldest operating family farm in BC's Gulf Islands and now part of a Class A provincial park. Guests rent the entire house via Airbnb and enjoy sweeping pastoral views, handcrafted period woodwork, and access to on-site farm-to-table meals and picnic baskets. Accredited by the BC Accommodations Association, it offers a genuinely immersive heritage experience for cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island.

address.value: 1801 Beaver Point Road, Salt Spring Island, B.C. V8K 1W3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Alfred House is a whole 4-bedroom heritage home at Ruckle Heritage Farm on Salt Spring Island, bookable via Airbnb, with wifi explicitly confirmed ('wifi is available in all but the Apple House'). Farm-to-table breakfast, dinner, and picnic basket options are all stated as available on-site. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are referenced anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. The OSM community tag lists 'Sidney,' which conflicts with the clearly stated Salt Spring Island address; the coordinates (48.77°N, 123.38°W) match Salt Spring Island, not Sidney.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the property is clearly on Salt Spring Island (address 1801 Beaver Point Road, Salt Spring Island); coordinates also match Salt Spring Island, not Sidney — OSM community tag appears to be an error.
OSM record carries no address or phone number; both were sourced exclusively from the website.
Bookings are handled via Airbnb, not directly through the farm website; the OSM URL points to the general accommodations page shared by all three properties, not an Alfred House-specific page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Alfred House is a legitimate, actively bookable heritage accommodation on Salt Spring Island with on-site food options and wifi; it is a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Gulf Islands circuit, pending confirmation of bike storage arrangements.
